data.one_liner: Zero-dependency dot-matrix and LED loading animations for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides dot-matrix loading animations, AI chat thinking indicators, 60 built-in LED patterns, and scrolling marquee text rendered natively via CustomPainter. Supports custom pixel frames, shape masks, and playback controls.
use_when: You need an AI chat typing or thinking indicator with more character than a standard spinner.
You want a retro LED dot-matrix display or scrolling marquee text for loading states.
You want custom pixel-art or frame-by-frame animations with zero external dependencies.
avoid_when: You need a standard circular progress arc or generic Material spinner.
You require complex vector or After-Effects style animations.
strengths: Zero external dependencies, built entirely with CustomPainter.
Includes 60 built-in patterns and built-in 5x7 font for scrolling text.
Supports accessibility with semantics labels and respects reduced motion settings.
weaknesses: Limited to dot-matrix, LED grid, and pixel-art aesthetics.
Not suited for standard UI layout or complex illustrations.
